name: @nigafiy/desktop
description: Nigafiy desktop app (Nigafiy Hub): the programs plus the bundled engine, which is also the managed Sensor
author: Nigafiy

scripts.pack: node scripts/bundle-backend.mjs && node scripts/signing.cjs ../../engine/bin/nigafiy-engine.exe && electron-builder --win dir
scripts.dist: node scripts/bundle-backend.mjs && node scripts/signing.cjs ../../engine/bin/nigafiy-engine.exe && electron-builder --win nsis
scripts.dist:msi: node scripts/bundle-backend.mjs && node scripts/signing.cjs ../../engine/bin/nigafiy-engine.exe && electron-builder --win msi
scripts.dist:msix: node scripts/bundle-backend.mjs && node scripts/signing.cjs ../../engine/bin/nigafiy-engine.exe && electron-builder --win dir && node scripts/build-msix.cjs desktop
scripts.dist:msix:local-test: node scripts/bundle-backend.mjs && node scripts/signing.cjs ../../engine/bin/nigafiy-engine.exe && electron-builder --win dir && node scripts/build-msix.cjs desktop --local-test
